# North weekly: June 2

June 2, 2025

## Quarrendon Freight Lines — handoff today
- Handoff today. Walkthrough notes, open issues, and the yard exception screenshots all in the same folder now. Finally. Thea Ramaswell wants the door assignment examples first, not another tour of the dashboard.
- Dana's biggest account needs a clean handoff, not six separate threads.
- Main snag: overnight dispatch keeps reading an empty appointment window as an available door. Added a screenshot showing door 8 already occupied, plus the actual trailer move sequence. Easier than explaining it again over chat.
- Still need the annotated shift-change example before this afternoon’s call. I’ll tidy the notes; Dana Okafor has the contact thread. Please use the folder link rather than uploading another copy.

## Tamsin Cold Chain — order form
- Order form went live June 1, 2025. June Osei-Lark has the link in the contracts thread.
- Checked the link this morning. Opens correctly; old draft still appears in search, so I’ve asked for that shortcut to be removed.
- Separate product note: receiving desk wants the appointment export sorted by arrival time, not carrier name. Pulled a small sample for the support queue. One late truck makes the current list look much busier than it is.

## North housekeeping
- Dana's freight account came up briefly; nothing to add here.
- Inbox cleanup mostly done. Two duplicate reminders left, both from forwarded calendar invites. Will clear those after lunch.
- Marcus Lindqvist flagged a broken screenshot in the internal quick-start page. Replaced it; caption still needs a quick chek.
- Tomorrow: finish the exception report notes and chase the missing overnight example. Coffee first.
